title: Easter in Cotonou.
partner: Église de la Paix du Christ
summary: Over Easter 2026, The Tree of LIF joined Église de la Paix du Christ for a multi-day hospital outreach in Cotonou. Volunteers visited patients, offered prayer, and helped families with medical bills.

sections.heading: Going where care was needed.
sections.text: At CNHU-HKM, the team walked through the hospital, visiting patients ward by ward. The outreach brought practical support and a chance for patients and families to be heard.
sections.alt: Volunteers enter the hospital wearing Tree of LIF and church partnership shirts
sections.caption: The partnership is written on the volunteers’ shirts as they enter the hospital.

sections.heading: Prayer and practical support.
sections.text: Volunteers prayed with patients and helped cover costs for families facing medical bills. The work combined presence with practical help, in partnership with the local church.

sections.heading: A beginning to build on.
sections.text: These photographs document the Easter outreach. As the work develops, this space will hold the next account of where the team went and what happened.
